# fireworks_dataset (Resource)

A dataset for fine-tuning or evaluation. Attributes are immutable; changes force replacement.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "fireworks_dataset" "training" {
  dataset_id    = "training-data-v1"
  display_name  = "Training data v1"
  external_url  = "gs://my-bucket/train.jsonl"
  format        = "CHAT"
  example_count = 1200
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `dataset_id` (String) User-chosen dataset identifier.

### Optional

- `display_name` (String) Human-readable name.
- `example_count` (Number) Number of examples in the dataset. Required by the API when external_url is not set (uploaded datasets).
- `external_url` (String) External URI of the dataset contents, e.g. gs://bucket/data.jsonl.
- `format` (String) Dataset format: CHAT, COMPLETION, or RL.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Same as dataset_id.
- `name` (String) Full resource name, e.g. accounts/my-account/datasets/my-dataset.
- `state` (String) Dataset state (UPLOADING, READY).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import fireworks_dataset.training <dataset-id>
```
